Krylya Sovetov vs Zenit Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Krylya Sovetov welcome Zenit to Samara for a Russian Premier League fixture on Monday, 2 November 2026. Kickoff is scheduled for 15:00 UTC at Solidarnost Arena, the home ground of Krylya Sovetov. The match falls in the middle of the 2026–27 league campaign, with both sides having played 12 matches so far.

Zenit arrive in second place on 27 points after a run of five consecutive victories, while Krylya Sovetov sit ninth with 15 points from three wins, six draws and three defeats. The visitors hold a 12-point advantage over the hosts and boast the league’s second-best attack with 27 goals scored. Krylya Sovetov have been harder to beat at home but face a Zenit side in excellent form.

Why This Match Matters

Zenit are chasing Dinamo Moskva at the top of the table and cannot afford to drop points against a mid-table side if they want to keep the title race alive. A win would move them level on points with the leaders, albeit having played a game fewer. For Krylya Sovetov, three points would lift them into the top half and extend their unbeaten home run, while a defeat could see them slide closer to the relegation play-off zone.

The fixture also carries historical weight: Zenit have dominated recent head-to-head meetings, winning four of the last five league encounters. Krylya Sovetov’s sole victory in that span came at the Gazprom Arena in December 2024, but they have managed draws in two of the last three visits to Samara.
